text.card: A red giant 3,839 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 0.85 solar masses and 7.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,650 K at its surface.
